verification.note: Verified on an earlier code commit; later documentation commits are not automatically covered.

status_meanings.done: Implemented or documented, with listed evidence. Historical build evidence may not cover later changes.
status_meanings.partial: Some code exists, but acceptance conditions are not yet met.
status_meanings.excluded: Intentionally not part of authorized offline application. Never count as unfinished work.
